def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = params[9]
    c = np.cos(w*t); s = np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[0] + params[1]*x + params[2]*x**2 + params[3]*x**3 + params[4]*np.sin(x)
            + params[5]*np.cos(x) + params[6]*np.exp(-x) + params[7]*c + params[8]*s
            + v*(params[1]*0 + 0.0) + v*c*0 )
